messages:
Sara (Sales): Acme POC failing to parse tool outputs when model emits nested arrays. App error: "Failed to parse function output: Expecting value at line 1 column 2". They also hit a few 429s. Need triage and can we offer short Dedicated credits?

Ben (Eng): What model/version and raw output? REST or SDK? streaming? Any runtime logs (decode/truncation)?

Sara (Sales): REST, not streaming. Model redwood/gpt-3.5x-mix. Raw snippet: [ {"action":"open_file","path":"src/main.py"}, , {"action":"replace","path":"src/lib.rs","lines":[1,2,3]} ] (note the stray comma). Also sometimes responses start with a UTF-8 BOM.

Ben (Eng): Stray comma explains parse error. Causes: model output drift with deep nesting or truncation from token/batching limits. Check inference logs; decode_error at kv_cache.py:112 would indicate truncation or cache write failure.

DeployBot: Rate-limiter: client=acme-poc, policy=per-tenant-qps, window=60s, events: 429 x3 between 1923456860-1923456880. qps=19/20.

Marta (Solutions): Short-term fixes: use an envelope like {"result": <array>} or base64 payloads. We also have runtime sanitizer toggles: sanitize_json=true and tolerate_bom=true to strip BOMs and fix trailing commas.

Ben (Eng): I can enable tolerant_json for the tenant (attempts to repair common issues) and open an infra ticket for kv_cache. Workaround: reduce max_batch_tokens or pin to Dedicated to avoid batch-induced truncation. I'll push canary now, ETA ~30–45m.

Account Exec: I'll draft a 2-week Dedicated trial + small POC credit for pricing; will email terms.

Ben (Eng): Canary deploy log: deploy: canary toggle tolerant_json for tenant=acme-poc -> success. Infra ticket INF-4521 created for kv_cache decode_error.

Acme QA: After toggle the next run removed BOM and no stray comma; parser accepted the output.

Sara (Sales): Thanks team. I'll update the customer and await Account Exec. Reopen if 429s or decode errors recur. :thumbsup:
